headline: Samsung Electronics deploys ChatGPT and Codex enterprise-wide, marking a major AI rollout.

items.title: Samsung Electronics brings ChatGPT and Codex to employees
items.summary: Samsung Electronics has rolled out ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to its employees globally. This deployment represents one of OpenAI's largest enterprise AI implementations to date. The initiative aims to enhance productivity through AI-driven tools that assist with coding and internal communication. By integrating these models, Samsung is leveraging advanced AI to streamline operations and improve efficiency across its workforce.
items.why_it_matters: Tech leads should note the increasing trend of major corporations adopting AI at scale, indicating a shift towards AI-driven enterprise solutions.

items.title: calesthio/OpenMontage
items.summary: OpenMontage is an open-source, agentic video production system featuring 12 pipelines, 52 tools, and over 500 agent skills. It transforms AI coding assistants into comprehensive video production studios, enhancing AI's utility in multimedia content creation.
